verdict.rationale: Pomelo's docs show support for more than one prepaid rail. Tokenization covers Visa and Mastercard credit, debit and prepaid cards. A credit core manages the full credit lifecycle from line creation through authorization, collections and delinquency. Multi-app lets two card types share one plastic. Missing for 10: explicit evidence separating commercial credit from consumer credit programs, a dedicated card-program-types page listing debit/prepaid/credit, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
